faq.a: Belkis is associated with the Arabic form بلقيس, whose core sense is balqis (queen of sheba).

faq.q: What is the origin of Belkis?
faq.a: Belkis is associated with Arabic. Variant romanization of بلقيس, the name traditionally given to the Queen of Sheba. The source record's gloss 'Gazelle' is unsupported.
Yes — the underlying form بلقيس is Arabic.
Belkis can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Belkis should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The Queen of Sheba is referred to in the Qur'an (27:23-44) but is not named there

faq.q: What does Belkis mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Belkis is rendered بلقیس and carries the sense بلقیس (ملکہ سبا).

faq.a: No verified Persian form was established for Belkis.

faq.q: What are the variants of Belkis?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Belkis, belkis. Script forms are بلقيس, بلقیس, बेलकीस.

faq.q: Is Belkis a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
